name: chaos-audit
description: Six-phase adversarial reliability, concurrency, and failure-mode auditing skill for coding agents. Hunts TOCTOU races, duplicate webhook retries, deadlocks, missing timeouts, and non-atomic state writes -- proven with deterministic failing reproducer tests.

interface.longDescription: Orchestrates isolated hunters, adversarial disprovers, and zero-dependency ledger/findings validators to uncover race conditions, non-idempotent retries, connection-pool starvation, deadlocks, and LLM pipeline failures -- backed by executable reproducer tests.
defaultPrompt: Run a chaos audit on this codebase
Hunt race conditions, duplicate webhook retries, and missing timeouts in ./src
Verify whether our checkout and refund handlers are safe under concurrent requests
